name: qiaomu-opencli-explorer
tagline_zh: 写字的人会喜欢：qiaomu-opencli-explorer。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Use when creating a new OpenCLI adapter from scratch, adding support for a new website or platform, exploring a site's API endpoints via browser DevTools, or when a user asks to automatically generate a CLI for a website (e.g. "帮我生成 xxx.com 的 cli"). Covers automated generation, API discovery workflow, authentication strategy selection, TS adapter writing, and testing.
